notes.title: Cage of Roses has been released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm writing a quick announcement to let you know that my newest VN, [i]Cage of Roses[/i], has finally been released!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/341617e79554b0ba094ae0721a5f69a1dae11db3.png[/img]

I say 'finally' because I wrote the script for this VN all the way back in early 2021. It took about 4 years for me to get this project pieced together, but I'm very glad that I stuck with it until the bitter end!

I think the art by Rock CR and the music by Sarah Mancuso is especially lovely, and it really adds to the overall atmosphere of the story. They really went all-in on the pretty visuals and the ominous, eerie music, and I think it all comes together really nicely!

It's been a dream of mine to write a spooky vampire story for over a decade, and I'm very happy I was finally able to do that. I hope I did the idea justice!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33024327/e1337ddc7798b6b2474b10fa665becf331e0c2dd.png[/img]

You can check out the VN here if you're interested:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993720

Please let me know if you run into any bugs or typos, and I'll do my best to fix them within a reasonable timeframe.

Thank you, as always, for your support over the years. It's very much appreciated, and I hope you'll all enjoy my newest yuri story!

- ebi x

notes.title: Spanish (Latin American) translation added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I'm writing this quick update to let you know that [i]Rituals in the Dark[/i] has been translated into Latin American Spanish, thanks to the efforts of Hector Esquivel. I'm pleased that this [i]Rituals[/i] is now available in even more languages, so more people will be able to enjoy it!

As always, please let me know if you find any bugs or spelling errors/typos in the new update, and I will try to fix them all in a timely manner.

Thank you for your continued support over the years; it's very much appreciated!

- ebi

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Just writing a quick update to let you know that I've fixed a handful of typos which were pointed out in the story, both by people on the Steam community hub and a kind person on my Discord server. [i]Rituals in the Dark[/i] should read a little more nicely now!

As always, if you find any other issues in this VN (including further typos or any technical issues), do point them out, and I will try to fix them within a reasonable time frame!

Thank you very much for your continued support; it's very much appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: Trading cards added
notes.content:
Hi everybody!

I'm just writing a quick update to let you know that trading cards have (finally) been added to [i]Rituals in the Dark[/i]! The game has been approved for trading cards for a while now, but it took me some time to actually add them haha ;;

Nevertheless, I'm glad they're in the game now!

I hope you enjoy collecting the cards and the various points shop items!

- ebi x

notes.title: Chinese translation
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

As always, if you find any typos, bugs, or errors, don't hesitate to let me know. I am very conscious that each new update might accidentally break something...
